# ============================================================================
# CHAOS REDUX - EVENT 027 EXACT MASTERY ADAPTER
# ============================================================================
# Overview:
# - Re-reads native mastery at confirmation and after each one-point increment.
# - Stops only when the selected branch reaches exactly the next observed level.
# - Uses the owning doctrine filters, preserving banked mastery and native
#   completion behavior. Unknown or unresolvable levels fail closed.
# - Empty-track selection uses native set_sub_doctrine followed by the same
#   one-point/readback transaction, so adoption and the first step stay inside
#   the static built-in adapter boundary.
# ============================================================================

doctrine_research_exact_step_mobile_infantry_track_infantry = {
	set_temp_variable = { doctrine_research_transaction_step_guard = 0 }
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = doctrine_research_transaction_observed_level value = doctrine_research_transaction_expected_level compare = less_than }
			check_variable = { var = doctrine_research_transaction_step_guard value = constant:doctrine_research_event.mastery_point_loop_limit compare = less_than }
		}
		add_mastery = {
			amount = constant:doctrine_research_event.mastery_point_increment
			folder = land
			sub_doctrine = mobile_infantry
			track = infantry
			index = 0
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { doctrine_research_transaction_step_guard = constant:doctrine_research_event.mastery_point_increment }
		doctrine_research_capture_transaction_level = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = doctrine_research_transaction_observed_level value = doctrine_research_transaction_expected_level compare = equals } }
		set_temp_variable = { doctrine_research_transaction_success = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { doctrine_research_transaction_post_level = doctrine_research_transaction_observed_level }
	}
}

doctrine_research_apply_mastery = {
	if = {
		limit = { doctrine_research_mastery_transaction_is_verified = yes check_variable = { var = doctrine_research_selected_domain value = constant:doctrine_research_domain.special_forces compare = equals } }
		doctrine_research_apply_special_forces_mastery = yes
	}
	else = { doctrine_research_apply_exact_mastery = yes }
}

doctrine_research_apply_empty_track_mastery = {
	set_temp_variable = { doctrine_research_transaction_success = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { doctrine_research_transaction_post_level = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { doctrine_research_transaction_native_completed = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { doctrine_research_mastery_transaction_is_verified = yes doctrine_research_empty_track_is_verified = yes doctrine_research_selected_empty_subdoctrine_is_valid = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = doctrine_research_selected_domain value = constant:doctrine_research_domain.special_forces compare = equals } }
			doctrine_research_apply_special_forces_empty_track_mastery = yes
		}
		else = { doctrine_research_apply_ordinary_empty_track_mastery = yes }
		# A native-completion edge is valid only when set_sub_doctrine actually
		# occupied the selected track. If the engine rejected the assignment,
		# leave the receipt unresolved so the caller quarantines it instead of
		# treating a failed adoption as a banked-mastery result.
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = doctrine_research_transaction_native_completed value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				doctrine_research_selected_track_is_empty = yes
			}
			set_temp_variable = { doctrine_research_transaction_native_completed = 0 }
		}
	}
}
